Name: esm2_model_scale_fitness
Title: Scaling Laws for Protein Fitness Prediction: Does ESM-2 Model Size Matter?
Experiment: Swap the ESM-2 backbone across four model sizes (esm2_t6_8M_UR50D, esm2_t12_35M_UR50D, esm2_t30_150M_UR50D, esm2_t33_650M_UR50D) while keeping the MLP head and training procedure identical. For each model size, record final Spearman correlation and MSE on the held-out test set. Plot Spearman vs. number of ESM-2 parameters on a log scale to reveal whether fitness prediction follows a scaling law, and report the cost-benefit tradeoff between embedding quality and compute.
